12070.title: feat(llms): add prompt caching for Anthropic models
12070.body:
Adds prompt caching for Anthropic models. Spice marks the system prompt and the dataset schema block as cacheable, so a repeated NSQL or chat request reuses them instead of resending them.

On a 40-dataset spicepod the cached prefix is about 18k tokens. Time to first token on a warm cache dropped from 2.4s to 0.6s in local measurement.

```yaml
models:
  - name: claude
    from: anthropic:claude-opus-5
    params:
      prompt_cache: enabled # 'enabled' or 'disabled' (default)
```

12073.title: fix(search): stop rrf() from dropping ties at the top-k boundary
12073.body:
When two documents had an identical fused score at the top-k cutoff, `rrf()` kept whichever the hash map yielded first, so the same query returned different results between runs.

The fused ranking now breaks ties on the document key, which is stable. A query with tied scores returns the same rows every time.

12074.title: fix(tests): update snapshots after the rrf change

12077.title: fix(mongodb): resume from the stored token after a replica set failover
12077.body:
After a MongoDB replica set failover the change stream reconnected to the new primary and restarted from the current time instead of the stored resume token. Every change written during the failover window was lost from the acceleration.

The connector now passes the stored resume token on reconnect. Where the token is no longer valid on the new primary, the dataset fails the refresh with a structured error naming the collection instead of silently skipping the gap.

This was a data-loss bug.
